2) Invoice remittance: You indicated ap@steadyforge.com. Can you confirm whether your AP mailbox consumes attachments or expects a specific subject line (we can include PO# automatically).
3) Portal vs email: We're fine with email for invoices, but when you share bank info please use our secure vendor portal. See the link below; we'll generate a secure upload token with an expiry.

Secure portal link (one-time token request): https://vendors.redwood.com/upload-request?id=REQ-7721

Kimberly — can you confirm SLA targets and whether SteadyForge needs any special tax or 1099 handling flagged in the vendor record?

Thanks all — once those three items are confirmed we will: (a) create the vendor master record, (b) set up PO routing rules, and (c) issue the first test PO to validate acknowledgements and invoice pathing.
